t: 安妮王后是玛丽二世的妹妹,成为英格兰,苏格兰,爱尔兰的王后.
te: Queen Anne, the younger sister of Mary II, becomes Queen regnant of England, Scotland, and Ireland.
dz: 安妮王后是玛丽二世的妹妹,成为英格兰,苏格兰,爱尔兰的王后.
de: Queen Anne, the younger sister of Mary II, becomes Queen regnant of England, Scotland, and Ireland.

t: "库兰特日报"(英语:Daily Courant)是英国第一家全国性日报,首次出版.
te: The Daily Courant, England's first national daily newspaper, is published for the first time.
dz: "库兰特日报"(英语:Daily Courant)是英国第一家全国性日报,首次出版.
de: The Daily Courant, England's first national daily newspaper, is published for the first time.

t: 盎格鲁-荷兰部队在尼梅根城墙前与法国部队相撞并阻止其倒下.
te: Anglo-Dutch forces skirmish with French forces before the walls of Nijmegen and prevent its fall.
dz: 盎格鲁-荷兰部队在尼梅根城墙前与法国部队相撞并阻止其倒下.
de: Anglo-Dutch forces skirmish with French forces before the walls of Nijmegen and prevent its fall.

t: 强者奥古斯都二世率领的数量上占优势的波兰撒克逊军队，在有利的防御位置作战，在克利索战役中被国王…
te: A numerically superior Polish-Saxon army of Augustus II the Strong, operating from an advantageous defensive position, …
dz: 大北方战争：强者奥古斯都二世率领的数量上占优势的波兰撒克逊军队，在有利的防御位置作战，在克利索战役中被国王查理十二指挥下的瑞典军队击败，其规模只有其一半。
de: Great Northern War: A numerically superior Polish-Saxon army of Augustus II the Strong, operating from an advantageous defensive position, is defeated by a Swedish army half its size under the command of King Charles XII in the Battle of Klissow.

t: 盎格鲁-荷兰军队由马尔伯勒公爵和阿特隆伯爵统治,在西班牙继承战争中攻克列日.
te: Anglo-Dutch forces, under the Duke of Marlborough and Earl of Athlone, capture Liège during the War of the Spanish Succ…
dz: 盎格鲁-荷兰军队由马尔伯勒公爵和阿特隆伯爵统治,在西班牙继承战争中攻克列日.
de: Anglo-Dutch forces, under the Duke of Marlborough and Earl of Athlone, capture Liège during the War of the Spanish Succession.

t: 在安妮王后战争期间由詹姆斯·摩尔(James Moore)指挥的英国殖民者围攻西班牙圣奥古斯丁.
te: English colonists under the command of James Moore besiege Spanish St. Augustine during Queen Anne's War.
dz: 在安妮王后战争期间由詹姆斯·摩尔(James Moore)指挥的英国殖民者围攻西班牙圣奥古斯丁.
de: English colonists under the command of James Moore besiege Spanish St. Augustine during Queen Anne's War.

t: 卡罗来纳州州长詹姆斯·摩尔放弃了圣奥古斯丁围城.
te: James Moore, Governor of the Province of Carolina, abandons the Siege of St. Augustine.
dz: 安妮王后之战:卡罗来纳州州长詹姆斯·摩尔放弃了圣奥古斯丁围城.
de: Queen Anne's War: James Moore, Governor of the Province of Carolina, abandons the Siege of St. Augustine.
